title: Can deterministic chart condensation shrink an 18 MB medical record by 99% without losing active problems, drug conflicts, or privacy protections?
summary: Before putting an AI model in the loop, we tested our chart condenser and clinical rule engine on 32 test cases across 53 years of multi-clinic records. The test checked whether shrinking an 18 MB health export into 2k–8k token summaries preserves all active conditions and allergies, catches 15 planted cross-clinic prescription and staging conflicts, and blocks sensitive mental-health or substance-use records when sharing externally.
takeaway: The condenser and rule engine passed all 32 test cases at every summary size (8k, 4k, and 2k tokens), shrinking a 53-year chart by over 99.6% while keeping 100% of active medications and allergies, catching all 15 cross-clinic conflicts with clickable source links, and blocking 100% of sensitive records in external-share mode.
